name: comment-guard
description: A single-plugin marketplace for comment-guard, a hook that surfaces newly landed comment lines and newly bloated markdown for review.

plugins.name: comment-guard
plugins.description: Lists every comment line that lands in your working tree -- from an edit, a heredoc, a sed -i, or a git merge -- at the one moment when cutting it is still cheap, and hands back a four-part rule for deciding. Watches markdown too, where the signal is not the lines but the shape: prose that narrates the change, growth that replaced nothing, a file already too long to read.
